apps/web/components/shell/ShellMetadataC.empty: The chip renders one caller-supplied label and owns no collection that could be empty. The detector matched the items-center class in 'inline-flex h-5 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 ...' and the word rows in its doc comment.

apps/web/components/shell/SidebarNavItem.empty: The row renders one nav item and owns no collection that could be empty. The detector matched the items-center class in 'relative grid items-center rounded-full ...' and the word rows in the comment 'These rows never render a trailing action'.

apps/web/components/shell/SidebarThreads.offline: The section fetches nothing: it renders threads and a caller-owned state of idle, loading or error, so there is no offline branch. The detector matched the loading value in "export type SidebarThreadListState = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'error';".

apps/web/components/shell/StatusBadge.ts.partial: status is the only data prop and every status renders its full dot, label and tooltip from STATUS_CHIP, so no field can be missing; className is styling only.
apps/web/components/shell/StatusBadge.ts.long-content: Labels come from the fixed STATUS_CHIP map (longest is 'Announced') and no prop carries caller text, so a long label cannot be rendered.

apps/web/components/shell/TaskStatusIcon.empty: The glyph renders one status and owns no collection. The detector matched the word list in the doc comment 'Linear-style task list states' and the items-center class.
apps/web/components/shell/TaskStatusIcon.partial: status is the only data prop and every status renders a complete glyph; agentRunning only adds a pulse and className is styling, so no field can be missing.
apps/web/components/shell/TaskStatusIcon.long-content: The glyph renders no caller text; its accessible names are fixed strings such as aria-label='Backlog', which is what the detector matched as label.
apps/web/components/shell/TaskStatusIcon.permission-denied: The glyph has no permission concept. The detector matched role='img' on the in-progress and done glyphs.
